analyst.summary: GMM Pfaudler is the global market leader in glass-lined equipment for pharma and chemical manufacturing, a business with real technical moats. But recent quarters have been volatile, including an outright loss in one quarter, margins have compressed sharply within the year, debt has risen, and promoter shareholding has fallen to a low ~25%. We rate it a Hold per the model, but flag that the current quality picture looks meaningfully weaker than the scorecard's own return-on-equity inputs suggest, and think this is worth an independent look.
